notes: Top-down white espresso cup + saucer with clear golden crema on warm honey wood planks; very on-palette. Saucer sits roughly centred, cup slightly up-left in a centre square crop. Runner-up (Trent Erwin) is a perfectly centred square shot on bright white with a red-orange saucer, paler crema. Runner-up: Trent Erwin, https://unsplash.com/photos/flat-lay-photography-teacup-on-top-of-saucer-fKImVjUwkXc. Licence: Unsplash License (free, not Unsplash+); both verified premium=false/plus=false.

Square overhead shot: classic cappuccino with cocoa-flecked foam and a rosetta, white cup/saucer on mid-tone oak; fills ~80% of the circle. Unsplash titles it "cafe latte" but it reads clearly as a cappuccino. Runner-up: overhead rosetta cup on a speckled blue-rim saucer, warm wood. Runner-up: Phil Aicken, https://unsplash.com/photos/white-ceramic-cup-with-saucer-on-brown-wooden-table-yNAthbYlHyU. Licence: Unsplash License (free, not Unsplash+); both verified premium=false/plus=false.

Overhead heart latte art in a white cup on a pale saucer and white marble; bright, creamy, centred, fills ~75% of the circle. The cleanest cut-out look in the set. Runner-up: big overhead tulip-heart latte on a red saucer on marble (landscape, red strip at far left edge falls outside a centre crop). Runner-up: Holly Landkammer, https://unsplash.com/photos/a-cup-of-coffee-with-a-swirl-in-it-Hvehlz3P2BE. Licence: Unsplash License (free, not Unsplash+); both verified premium=false/plus=false.

Overhead rosetta with a tight golden crema ring in a navy-rim enamel cup on light warm oak: reads as a flat white and differs from the latte. Subject is slightly left of centre but stays inside the circle. Runner-up: centred rosetta-heart white cup on darker rustic wood. Runner-up: Lex Sirikiat, https://unsplash.com/photos/coffee-on-white-ceramic-mug-1tEkissU8dY. Licence: Unsplash License (free, not Unsplash+); both verified premium=false/plus=false.

Square, side view: layered iced macchiato in a ribbed clear glass, caramel drizzle on a cream top, on a wood-slice coaster. Plain light neutral (cool grey-lilac) background, fills ~70%. Runner-up: caramel-drizzled can-glass with a gold straw on warm wood, busier background. Runner-up: Keith Brian de Leon, https://unsplash.com/photos/a-glass-with-a-drink-in-it-1EV6hDgDpFM. Licence: Unsplash License (free, not Unsplash+); both verified premium=false/plus=false.

Overhead chocolate-toned latte with a rosetta in a red-rim white cup and saucer on white marble; bright and centred. The cocoa colour sets it apart from the latte. Runner-up: whipped cream with chocolate shavings in a glass mug, soft light background (a classic mocha cue). Runner-up: Shayna Douglas, https://unsplash.com/photos/ice-cream-with-white-cream-on-clear-glass-cup-e-8xxuZfSMw. Licence: Unsplash License (free, not Unsplash+); both verified premium=false/plus=false.

Tight overhead shot of black coffee with crema bubbles in a white mug on warm blurred wood; fills ~85% (rim close to the circle edge). Warm and appetising. Runner-up: same photographer, overhead mug on sunlit light oak planks with strong shadow. Runner-up: Nathan Dumlao, https://unsplash.com/photos/white-ceramic-mug-on-brown-wooden-surface-iSUg73OJm7E. Licence: Unsplash License (free, not Unsplash+); both verified premium=false/plus=false.

Clean, slightly-high side view of a layered iced latte in a clear tumbler (milky base, coffee and ice on top) on a plain light grey-white surface. Centred, minimal cut-out feel. Subject is ~50% of the frame, so it may need a slight zoom/scale in the circle. Runner-up: very milky layered iced latte on warm wood, fills more but has a dark green bokeh background.
